decisions.reason: Premium support fits the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock expert support strategy and generates recurring revenue at low incremental cost.
The version management tool is built into the hosting platform and reduces recurring operational work for customers, so it supports the firm's core value proposition.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core business, but it serves GDPR compliance needs for hosting customers and costs little to maintain, so keeping it is slightly more likely than dropping it.
Scalable agency hosting is central to the firm's agency-focused strategy and was featured prominently on the home page.
